title: Art Master Series – Watercolour Landscape Painting Workshop with Ong Kim Seng
description: Paint alongside celebrated Singaporean watercolourist Ong Kim Seng in this outdoor plein air session at Chinatown. You'll start with 45 mins of sketching, then dive into watercolour techniques on-site and back at the studio. Great for beginners and experienced painters alike — all materials included, and you get to bring your masterpiece home.
